name: meanrev-breadth7-pure-v1
description: Pure-chain follow-up to meanrev-breadth-v1 (artifact 68be3db1), pre-registered per the task protocol: 'if the winner comes out of a mixed chain, run the pure chain of the best alternate (1 candidate, 0 new trials)'. meanrev-breadth-v1's outer selection was MIXED: control-5x10 won folds 0/1/3, breadth-7x10 won folds 2/5, breadth-10x10 won fold 4 — the reported 'selected: breadth-7x10' name is only the LAST fold's inner winner (summary.selectedCandidate is not the stitched chain's owner; see summary.outerSelection). Among the two non-control breadth points, 7x10 won more inner selections (2/6 vs 1/6 for 10x10) and has the higher inner median DSR/Sharpe (0.288/0.949 vs whatever 10x10 posted) reported in that summary, so it is the 'best alternate' by the manifest's own selection criterion. ONE candidate here: breadth-7x10 (maxPositions 7, slotPct 0.10, same RSI2/SMA200/exit/timeStop/hardStop volScaled k3-20-2-12 as the control), everything else FROZEN identical to meanrev-breadth-v1/meanrev-control-pure-v1 (same 32-symbol universe, window 2018-01-01..2026-08-06, 6x3 purged folds, base/stress costs, same evidence gates). This produces breadth-7x10's OWN pure OOS chain (outerSelection uniformly breadth-7x10 by construction, 3/3... 6/6 folds), directly comparable fold-for-fold to meanrev-control-pure-v1's pure chain (artifact 01d92c2a) — the comparison the mixed chain in meanrev-breadth-v1 cannot honestly support. TRIAL ACCOUNTING: breadth-7x10 is NOT a new hypothesis — it was already declared and run as one of meanrev-breadth-v1's 3 pre-registered candidates (which itself added +2 new hypotheses, bringing the meanrev running total to 27). Isolating it into its own single-candidate manifest is an execution identity (same candidate x cost tier x fold geometry), so this manifest adds 0. priorUniqueTrials=27.
